subject: 哈尔滨文庙 · 大成殿正面（含月台与汉白玉栏杆）
name: 哈尔滨文庙大成殿
sub: 十一开间重檐庑殿大成殿
yearNote: 民国十五年十月（1926）动工，民国十八年十一月（1929）建成，年份取建成年。殿为仿清官式而内外金柱改用钢筋混凝土的近代建筑，不按清代古建分类。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q10922002（哈尔滨文庙 Harbin Confucian Temple）P625 坐标 45.77302, 126.66883，文庙近似坐标，非大成殿实测；地图显示点复用既有 harbin。
lede: 1926年动工、1929年落成的哈尔滨文庙，是中国最后建成的一座文庙，也是东北规模最大、规格最高的一座。大成殿用了堂九夹室二的十一开间，重檐庑殿顶覆黄琉璃瓦，月台三面出陛，内外金柱却已换成钢筋混凝土，是清式法式与新材料并行的一例。
facts: 年代：民国十五年（1926）十月动工，十八年（1929）十一月建成，东省特别区长官张焕相、张景惠倡建，张学良题碑记；1996年列第四批国保，1985年起为省民族博物馆馆舍。
形制：面阔十一间、进深六间，重檐庑殿黄琉璃瓦顶；月台三面出陛各十级，前正中一陛置汉白玉五龙戏珠御路，台明与月台四周绕汉白玉勾栏；里外金柱为钢筋混凝土。
图版：取2017年正对殿前的实拍，逐根核对十二根前檐柱、十一开间与两道檐口；殿前铜鼎、盆景、说明牌与游人去除，殿顶走兽按实拍保留。
caption: 哈尔滨文庙 · 十一开间大成殿
民国 · 1926–1929
structure_checkpoints: 开间：前檐可数十二根红色圆柱（“红度”剖面检出12根，间距自左至右约362/352/347/417/457/520/477/427/378/378/462像素，明间最宽），分出十一开间；每间为格扇门（中部）或槛窗（两端），全部为深红木格带金线。
屋顶：重檐庑殿，上檐正脊两端大吻、四条垂脊，下檐绕殿一周；两道檐下各一圈斗栱与青绿彩画额枋，上檐下正中悬“大成殿”竖匾（匾留空不写字）。
台基与月台：高台基，正面突出月台；月台正面三出陛（中为御路浮雕），左右各一出陛，全部为汉白玉望柱栏杆围合，栏板有透雕纹样。
附属：殿前铜鼎香炉一座、花盆、说明牌、红色隔离绳均为现代物，去除；两侧配殿与树木不入图。
material_observations: 屋面黄色琉璃筒瓦，脊饰黄琉璃；斗栱、额枋青绿彩画加金线、朱红地；柱身与门窗深红近赭，格心金线；台基灰白花岗石，栏杆汉白玉；地面青灰石板。
author: Huanokinhejo

additional_sources.author: Jason（picasaweb）
additional_sources.role: 2008年正面低分辨率照片，核对屋脊、匾额位置与月台；不作计数依据。

source_note: 主图为 Huanokinhejo 2017 年 7 月正对殿前的实拍（CC BY-SA 4.0，6000×4000），文件说明记殿长约70米、宽约35米、檐上十只走兽；经红柱检测与目视核对为十二柱十一间。补充图为 2008 年低分辨率正面（CC BY-SA 3.0）。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Dacheng Hall (大成殿) of the Harbin Confucian Temple (1926–1929), drawn straight on from Image 2 (2017 frontal photo); Image 3 is an older frontal photo for checking only. A very wide hall of ELEVEN bays defined by TWELVE red round columns across the front (central bay widest), with lattice doors in the middle bays and lattice windows in the end bays; a double-eave hip roof (upper roof with main ridge, big ridge-end ornaments and four diagonal ridges; a lower eave running all round), each eave carried on a continuous row of bracket-sets over painted beams; a vertical blank name-plaque under the upper eave centre. The hall stands on a high stone terrace; in front projects a moon platform with THREE stair flights on its front edge (the middle one with a carved ramp) and one flight at each side, the whole platform and terrace edge enclosed by a white marble balustrade of posts and pierced panels. Remove the bronze incense burner, potted plants, sign boards, red rope barriers, people, the side buildings and trees. Landscape 1536×1024, hall plus platform about 82% of width, roof ridge and terrace foot uncut.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
